showing only highway and trees. Recentering east on the white-roofed industrial

Way, Georgetown KY, Toyota's largest plant globally (~7.5M sq ft under roof on a
~1,300-acre campus, producing Camry/Camry Hybrid/RAV4 Hybrid/Lexus ES). Locked
campus center at 38.262, -84.535.

fieldNotes.site: Toyota's largest plant globally (~7.5M sq ft under roof, ~1,300-acre campus). Fully fenced, multi-building manufacturing campus with central assembly plant, two large inbound-logistics/cross-dock buildings on the SE side, powertrain/engine buildings, and a paint/utility cluster.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TMMK is a fully fenced, security-controlled campus. Toyota numbers its gates (visitor route uses 'Gate 2'). Street View on internal roads and at a perimeter fence line shows chain-link perimeter fencing with a cantilever/swing gate across an access drive. Truck gates are controlled checkpoints.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Manned guard houses are standard at Toyota assembly-plant primary gates and are visible as small structures near the entrance roundabouts in z16/z18 imagery; assigned true with high confidence given facility type, fenced perimeter and numbered-gate system.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Exceptional drop-yard scale: z19 imagery of the SE inbound-logistics complex shows hundreds of trailers packed in dense rows; Street View along the south perimeter shows a continuous line of parked trailers behind the berm. Easily 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Hundreds of dock doors across the inbound-logistics buildings and the assembly plant's multiple internal dock courtyards; 220 is a conservative honest estimate, 50+ band certain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has 10+ distinct large buildings (assembly plant, two logistics/cross-dock buildings, engine/powertrain shops, paint, utilities).
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur present; auto plants of this scale and the visible rail-served areas on the campus support railServed true (also seen as long red/pink rail-served rolling stock in z17/z18).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound parts/cross-dock logistics complex (SE) is physically separate from finished-vehicle outbound staging and from the assembly building dock courtyards.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane internal approach roads and large gate aprons leave clear room for express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Box covers the core fenced developed campus; outlying TMMK-owned land (test track, retention areas) extends beyond it.

fieldNotes.facilityType: Port of Long Beach vehicle processing & distribution center (TLS, ~180,000-200,000 vehicles/yr).
